reviews.text:
Promising Technology, but Disappointing Lack of Skin Tone Accuracy. I was excited to use this AI app to restore and animate old photographs, as the concept is impressive and the technology shows potential. Unfortunately, my experience has been disappointing due to a major issue with how the app handles skin tone and ethnicity.

Every photo I attempted to restore featuring Hispanic and brown-skinned individuals was altered to appear Caucasian with much lighter skin tones and facial features that did not accurately reflect the original person. This significantly changes the identity of the individuals in the photos and takes away from the purpose of preserving memories as they truly were.

AI restoration should enhance and respect the original image, not erase or replace cultural and ethnic characteristics. The lack of diversity and accurate representation is concerning and feels exclusionary.

Until the app improves its ability to correctly recognize and restore people of different skin tones and backgrounds, I cannot fully recommend it. Representation matters, especially when dealing with personal and historical images.
